author: みどり
text: Will the Bon dance go ahead even if it rains?

author: たけし
text: Last night so many cars were parked on the road behind the shrine that I couldn't get my car out of my house. Please do something about it.

author: ゆい
text: Will the yakisoba stall be there again this year? It was delicious last year, so I'm looking forward to it!

author: けんじ
text: I lost a blue children's water bottle. I think it was near the main tent.

author: さくら
text: An elderly man has collapsed next to the tower stage! Please call the first-aid staff!

author: まさる
text: The goldfish scooping seems more expensive than last year. I'd like an explanation of why.

author: あおい
text: What time do volunteers need to gather?

author: はるか
text: The fireworks woke my baby up. It would be nice if they could end a little earlier...

author: こうた
text: Where can I see the timetable for the extra buses?

author: ひろみ
text: I found a wallet on the ground, so I dropped it off at the main tent.

author: りょう
text: The trash bins are overflowing and litter is scattered on the street.

author: なつみ
text: It was fun again this year! Thank you to everyone who ran it.

author: しんじ
text: Excuse me, but could you kindly tell me where the smoking area is in the venue?

author: えり
text: I waited 30 minutes in line for takoyaki and it sold out right in front of me. What a fantastic festival.

author: だいき
text: The rotary in front of the station is jammed with pick-up cars and nothing is moving.

author: みか
text: My daughter is lost. She's a 5-year-old girl in a red yukata. If you see her, please contact the main tent!

author: ゆうすけ
text: My child who ate shaved ice says they feel a bit sick. Is there somewhere to rest?

author: あや
text: I dropped my phone. It has a black case with a cat sticker on the back.

author: のぶお
text: Can we apply to run a stall through this board again next year?

author: かおり
text: There are far too few toilets. It's really hard for people with kids.

author: たくや
text: The fireworks were amazing! I'll definitely come again next year.

author: まゆみ
text: Sorry for the trouble, but I would be grateful if you could guide me to a route passable by wheelchair.

author: けいた
text: One of the lantern decorations is about to fall and might hit people walking underneath.

author: ちひろ
text: I found a key with a bear keychain. Where should I take it?

author: ひでき
text: Earn 300,000 yen a month with a side job! Details at the link in my profile.

author: あきこ
text: As a neighbor, it would help if the music stage volume could be turned down a little.

author: そうた
text: Where's the bicycle parking?

author: れいこ
text: The man at the cotton candy stall was really kind. Thank you.

author: じゅん
text: I cut my foot and the bleeding won't stop. Do you at least have a bandage?

author: ともこ
text: I'd like to volunteer. Is it still possible to join?

author: まこと
text: I wrote the same thing last year, but once again there was no parking attendant this year.

author: ななみ
text: I just saw a pink hat in front of the main tent. I think someone lost it.

author: いさむ
text: Prices at every stall are tourist-trap prices. And this is supposed to be a local festival.

author: ゆか
text: Our cat got out. It's an orange tabby with a blue collar.

author: こうじ
text: Please tell me when the portable shrine will pass by.

author: みさき
text: Someone on a bench looks like they have heatstroke and is completely limp.

author: しょうへい
text: The trash sorting is confusing. Where should I throw away PET bottles?

author: えみ
text: I'm worried about tomorrow's weather. When will you decide if it's cancelled?

author: たつや
text: A drunk person is shouting on the street and the kids are scared.

author: さちこ
text: Are there any stalls that accept credit cards?

author: かずき
text: I wish the road closure had been announced earlier. I missed my bus.

author: りな
text: Is there anywhere that will help me put on a yukata?

author: ひろし
text: Classic organizers — every sign was pointing the wrong way.

author: あいこ
text: I lost my glasses. Black frames, no case.

author: ゆうた
text: There's an exposed cable behind the stage and someone tripped over it.

author: まり
text: Are there rules about taking photos? Can I post them on social media?

author: けん
text: Is there still space in the temporary parking lot?

author: ふみ
text: I look forward to it every year. Thank you in advance for this year too.

author: よしお
text: Exhaust from a stall's generator is blowing toward the seating area and it's smoky.

author: あすか
text: The lost boy found his mom. Thank you so much!

author: てつや
text: We apologize for troubling you when you are busy, but we kindly ask that you inform visitors to refrain from parking on the streets around the venue.

author: みずき
text: Isn't there a mask stall this year?

author: かつや
text: The shrine steps are dark and you can't see your feet.

author: ゆきこ
text: Someone left an umbrella behind. It's a clear plastic umbrella.

author: しゅん
text: Is it okay to come with a stroller? I'd like to know how crowded it is.

author: るみ
text: The grilled corn was undercooked. My child already ate it — will they be okay?

author: おさむ
text: Honestly, there were fewer stalls this year and it felt a little lonely.

author: ありさ
text: I lost my bicycle key. I can't get home and I'm stuck.

author: だいすけ
text: We're holding a used book fair in the neighborhood next month. Please come if you like!

author: はな
text: Can I join the Bon dance circle? Is it okay if I don't know the steps?
